steps.text: Tap Goals, then Start a savings goal.
Name the goal. Type the target amount, and what you've already saved.
Pick a target date, then tap Calculate from target date to see what to set aside each month.
The card shows how far along you are, and what you need each month to get there on time.
When you put money toward it, tap Add funds, pick or type an amount, and tap Add Funds.
